Outbound Services

Configure firewall rules for outbound IPv6 traffic.
Please note that your Sky Hub will automatically use the global prefix to configure the firewall rules. You only need to enter the Interface ID of the LAN device in the Source IPv6 LAN address field to apply the rule.
